items.title: Physical Natural Gas Prices Falter as Hints of Easing Demand, Excess Supply Suppress Bullish Sentiment
items.summary: Daily natural gas prices lost ground on Thursday as traders sized up a fundamental backdrop defined in large part by ample supply.

items.title: Appalachian Natural Gas Curtailments Loom as Storage Swells, Prices Sink
items.summary: It appears increasingly likely that Appalachian producers could again curtail some natural gas production this fall as regional storage inventories build and forward prices slide.

items.title: Storage Print Disappoints, Sends Natural Gas Futures Reeling
items.summary: Natural gas futures floundered on Thursday after a government inventory report proved bullish relative to historical norms but left stockpiles at hefty levels as shoulder season nears.

items.title: Western Natural Gas Forward Prices Climb as Permian, Northeast Hubs Retreat
items.summary: Natural gas forwards split down the middle during the Aug. 13–19 trading period as western hubs added more than 25 cents while West Texas and Northeast points shed close to 20 cents.

items.title: Midweek Momentum Fizzles for Amply Supplied Natural Gas Market
items.summary: A comfortable supply outlook kept New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) natural gas futures in negative territory on Thursday despite downwardly trending production and supportive heat in the forecast across much of the Lower 48.

items.title: Small Natural Gas Storage Build Masks Hefty Salt Draw
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported 16 Bcf injection into natural gas storage for the week ending Aug. 14, nearly matching expectations as a hefty South Central withdrawal limited the overall build.

items.title: Permian Natural Gas Supply Reshaped by 3-Mile Wells
items.summary: Permian Basin producers are increasingly turning to horizontal wells stretching more than three miles, a shift helping operators extract more hydrocarbons per well and supporting associated natural gas growth even with fewer rigs working the region.
